title: DR-22: out-of-sync only after authenticated current-epoch Commit fails
description: AGENTS.md: never delete group state on failure; mark out of sync and wait. Chosen by Mark 2026-10-18: a Member is marked out of sync only when a Commit for our current epoch (content type/epoch from the clear header) fails after OpenMLS verified its signature (InvalidCommit, or any error after process_message succeeds: AppDataRejected, InvalidAppDataUpdate, Missing*Component, InvalidComponentsList, TrailingAad on a Commit, merge errors). NOT marked: garbage, non-group messages, other groups (even same epoch number), past-epoch replays, future-epoch Commits (unauthenticatable), bad membership tags (checked before the signature), failed decryption, refused proposals or application messages. While marked, process/send/commit/merge_pending_commit/clear_pending_commit refuse with MemberError::OutOfSync and change nothing; recovery = a fresh Member via join_external or join_welcome.
